## Result

**Dark chart paint is observed; the combined acquisition failed before the dark
guide journey.** One run took approximately three seconds: 23 checks passed, then
`native Scheme selection is dark` failed. Its `passed:false` report is unchanged.
The seven-image task is incomplete; only the two chart images were produced.

| Observation | Result and boundary |
|---|---|
| Dark grade raster | Directly inspected original PNG: heading, A, green bar and `1,000` are visible without label clipping. |
| Dark call-chart raster | Directly inspected original PNG: heading, `find_symbol` / `1,234,567` and `references` / `1,000` are visible without label clipping. The small positive bar remains very thin; this is not full chart-quality acceptance. |
| Zoom and capture | Appearance200, DPR2, 720×500 CSS viewport, 1440×1000 physical PNGs. Chart boxes/scroll/focus unchanged across acquisition. No crop, scaling or pixel transformation. |
| Guide stop | Initial GET/assets/layout and native Tab to the unique Scheme control completed. `Home`, `ArrowDown`, `Tab` did not yield Dark. No guide POST, validation/repair/reset or dark guide capture occurred. |
| Inputs and CSS | All fourteen pinned inputs match before/after. A separate post-run review confirms both completed 33,879-byte app CSS bodies match the frozen CSS and all eleven selected active consumer files still match. The driver's final combined-workflow CSS assertions were **not reached**. |
| Lifecycle | Owned Chrome and fixture exit0, complete drains, no forced termination, final port refuses. No blocked page requests or recorded page/request/console errors before the assertion failure. This is not an OS-wide network or warning-free host claim. |

The grade target is x37/y239/w256/h22 at scrollY421; calls are
x37/y225/w560/h50 at scrollY713. Both top-level documents explicitly report dark.
Runtime: Node26.3.0, Playwright1.62.1, Chrome153.0.8010.53, bound by the contract.
Together with the separate light diagnosis this resolves the named chart-raster
omission, not the failed original matrix or the combined guide task.

The failed selection is an input-path observation, **not a diagnosed app defect**.
This revision records the failed postcondition, but not the select's value after
each key or native popup state. It cannot distinguish key-sequence semantics from
automation delivery. Do not repair the consumer or replace native input with
`selectOption` and describe it as the same keyboard test.

## Push-gate correction

Commit `4226020` reached main, but its invocation replaced PATH to select Go and
omitted the installed `/Users/geoff/go/bin/lefthook`. The generated pre-push wrapper
printed `Can't find lefthook in PATH` and returned success after fallback discovery;
the normal gate jobs did **not** run. The earlier full MCP/qualityplan tests passed,
but are not evidence that the hook or its Fathom static-plan gate ran.

Restoring the inherited PATH and invoking the resolved Lefthook1.13.6 after the push
initially skipped every job because main was already synchronized. That is not a
pass either. The corrective invocation uses the same pinned Go/cache environment,
prepends Go to inherited PATH, and runs the resolved runner with
`run pre-push --all-files --no-auto-install`. All three actual jobs passed:
decision-index, quality-evidence and Fathom static-plan verification (40 claimed
rows, zero failing). This is post-push verification, not a rewritten push history.
INC-70 adds I15's same-environment preflight and explicit non-skip requirement;
the installed hook, global configuration and runtime dependencies are unchanged.
Two 219-byte-total Swift fallback metadata files were moved from the otherwise
empty `.build` directory to the private evidence packet, not deleted.
